definitions.explanation: Financial or moral support given to help an organization, event, or cause. Often used in the context of membership or sponsorship of associations.

examples.japanese: {賛助|さんじょ}⟦{会員|かいいん}→会員：02535_kaiin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{募集|ぼしゅう}→募集：03035_boshuu⟧⟦しています→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{企業|きぎょう}→企業：00225_kigyou⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{賛助|さんじょ}{金|きん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けた→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
examples.english: We received sponsorship funding from a company.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦イベント→イベント：09594_ibento⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{団体|だんたい}→団体：03426_dantai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{賛助|さんじょ}⟦によって→によって：06801_niyotte⟧⟦{実現|じつげん}→実現：03276_jitsugen⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: This event was made possible through the support of many organizations.

notes:
USAGE:
Most commonly seen in {賛助|さんじょ}⟦{会員|かいいん}→会員：02535_kaiin⟧ (supporting member/associate member), a common membership category in Japanese organizations where members provide financial support without full voting rights.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {賛助|さんじょ}⟦{会員|かいいん}→会員：02535_kaiin⟧ (supporting member)
- {賛助|さんじょ}{金|きん} (sponsorship money)
- {賛助|さんじょ}⟦{出演|しゅつえん}→出演：11732_shutsuen⟧ (guest appearance in support)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{後援|こうえん}→後援：12616_kouen⟧: patronage, backing — broader support, often for events
- ⟦{協賛|きょうさん}→協賛：19226_kyousan⟧: co-sponsorship — joint support, often commercial
